summary: Frontend RBAC testing of FileDetailsPage.js across 4 roles (Admin, GP, Ops, Manager) on file 737a3e47-28a5-4132-9461-3eb196eae7bb. All 13 acceptance criteria from the review request PASS. Admin/Ops/Manager see Complete Lead Information, Profile Analysis, Bank Eligibilities, Update Status, Documents, Activity Log, and Check Eligibility button. GP correctly sees Complete Lead Information (with Edit Details), Documents, Activity Log, and Check Eligibility - and correctly does NOT see Profile Analysis, Bank Eligibilities, or Update Status. Check Eligibility button navigates to /admin/files/{id}/eligibility (separate page, not inline).

issues: React hydration warnings: <span> as child of <select>, <option>, <table>, <tbody>, <tfoot> (from data-ve-dynamic wrapper spans in Dashboard/VerifiedCallStats). Not blocking, but should be cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: Check Eligibility button hardcodes /admin/files/{id}/eligibility route for all roles including GP. When a GP clicks it from /agent/files/{id}, they will navigate under /admin/* which may 403 via ProtectedRoute. Should use role-aware path (e.g. /agent/files/{id}/eligibility for GP).

GP is granted Edit Details, document upload, and delete-document permissions via canEditLeadInfo — verify this matches product intent (RBAC summary in test_credentials.md says GP has 'Own Only' access).
user = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}') is fragile — a corrupt/missing user object will silently make everyone 'unauthorized'. Consider using a shared auth context.
File is 1249 lines — approaching guideline threshold (>700). Consider splitting into subcomponents (LeadInfoCard, ProfileAnalysisCard, BankEligibilityList, DocumentsPanel, ActivityLog).
generateFilePassword uses Date.now() so the password changes on every render/reload — it is not deterministic per file. Password shown to user is meaningless.
test_credentials: Used all 4 provided accounts from review_request; all logged in successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RBAC checks on FileDetailsPage verified: canEditLeadInfo (Admin/Ops/Manager/GP) and canEditBankInfo (Admin/Ops/Manager only) both function correctly. Check Eligibility navigation confirmed to /admin/files/{id}/eligibility. Note: same route used for GP too — may need role-aware routing.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found in the tested feature.
